# Private security backport

This is a private, source-controlled fork of http-cache-semantics 4.2.0, not a patched release published by the upstream maintainer. The original license is retained. The upstream package tarball was verified against its registry SHA-512 integrity before copying. PROVENANCE.json records original and patched source hashes.

Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp

The deployment gate must test the installed fork and verify every patched source file against the recorded hash. The normal dependency audit remains required for all other packages. Do not add an advisory ignore entry, weaken its severity threshold, or treat this source fork as an upstream fix. Replace this fork when a verified upstream correction is available.
